item.title: Over a dozen U.S. soldiers injured in attack on Saudi base as Iran-backed Houthis enter war
item.summary: An Iranian strike on an air base in Saudi Arabia wounded at least 15 U.S. service members. Israel also said it intercepted a missile launched from Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen.

item.title: Opinion: White House 'gamifying' Iran war updates
item.summary: The White House has depicted the war in Iran online with videos that weave real life images of missile strikes and destruction with clips from video games, sports clips, and action movies.

item.title: Rifts over Iran, but unity for Trump: Takeaways from CPAC 2026
item.summary: Members of the MAGA faithful gathered in Texas for the annual Conservative Political Action Conference. While tensions over Iran split some attendees, Trump remained the glue holding them together.

item.title: 'What if I die first?' Making a plan is key for family caregivers. Here's how
item.summary: People who care for an adult child, partner or sibling have to face the reality that their loved may outlive them. Planning ahead is key but it's not easy.

item.title: That was a fun movie. But where are the bloopers nowadays?
item.summary: Bloopers have usually been funny endnotes to funny movies. They peaked in the late 1990s and early 2000s, but are seemingly fading away.

item.title: There's a massive measles vaccine campaign in Mexico. Is the public on board?
item.summary: With tens of thousands of suspected cases, the government is aiming for 2.5 million jabs a week. The response has been encouraging — but also worrisome.

item.title: 'The Comeback' is back. That's something to Cherish
item.summary: The third (and final) installment of this Hollywood satire finds C-lister Valerie Cherish (Lisa Kudrow) helming an AI-written show.

item.title: Crossing the line: Emotional abuse in college sports
item.summary: Researchers have found that athletes experience emotional abuse more than any other form of harm. Some athletes maintain that this kind of abuse by coaches can cause lasting, even irreparable damage.

item.title: Stuck in a long TSA line? Here are some strategies if you need to rebook your flight
item.summary: Extreme TSA lines at airports have left many passengers scrambling to rebook flights missed due to delays. But while airlines say they're helping flyers, they're not obligated to do so.

item.title: The iconic South African theater that took on apartheid
item.summary: South Africa's iconic Market Theatre, born in the darkest days of apartheid and a force for change, is celebrating its 50th anniversary.
